correctness.rationale: Explicit exact determinant expansion in the quotient Z[z]/(z^4-z^2+1), the standard minor-rank criterion and the free 12-translation action provide a complete finite proof. The shipped standard-library verifier enumerates all 4356 orbit pairs, certifies 27 rank3, 757 rank4, 3572 rank5, and the raw multiplicities. Every representative finite-field check modulo 1009 also agrees, but is treated only as corroboration.

value.rationale: The natural fifth-order restrictions at the smallest non-squarefree mixed-prime order with exceptional size-five full-spark obstruction are important for exact five-frequency reconstruction. A rank-three restriction loses two independent coefficients, a failure not recorded by a determinant-zero predicate. The complete table gives every two-sided mask and its nullity; this is materially more informative than the earlier row-wise full-spark characterization or aggregate all-size vanishing counts.
